name: gizza-ai/treemap-chart
summary: Render hierarchical treemaps sized by value as deterministic SVG

tool.description: Render a hierarchical treemap from pasted rows: `label,value` for a flat chart, `parent/child,value` for paths, or `group,label,value` for a grouped table. Aggregates duplicate paths, sorts tiles, tiles the canvas with a squarified, slice-and-dice, or binary algorithm, and returns self-contained SVG by default or a summary table / JSON node list with values, shares, and tile rectangles. Options control layout detection, path separator, sort order, tiling algorithm, depth cap, top-N grouping into an Other tile, label/value/percentage display, label position, font size, colour palette, mono base colour, background, tile gap, corner radius, title, legend, canvas size, and theme. Everything runs locally in pure Rust; no plotting service, fonts, or external data are used.

background.description: Chart background colour, for example #ffffff or transparent. Default empty uses the theme background (white for light, dark slate for dark).

border_width.description: Gap/stroke width between tiles in pixels, 0-12. Default 2; use 0 for a seamless mosaic.

color.description: Base colour for palette=mono, as CSS colour text such as #2563eb, #f00, or tomato. Default #2563eb. Named colours are used as-is without the lightness ramp.

corner_radius.description: Rounded corner radius of each tile in pixels, 0-24. Default 2; use 0 for square corners.

data.description: Rows to plot, one per line. Use `label,value` for a flat treemap, `parent/child,value` for hierarchical paths, or `group,label,value` for a grouped table; the last column is always the number. Comma, tab, semicolon, and single-space separated rows all work, a leading header row is skipped, `#` starts a comment, and values may carry thousands separators or a currency mark. Required.

font_size.description: Label font size in pixels, 6-48. Default 13. Larger values hide labels on small tiles because text is only drawn when it fits.

label_position.description: Vertical placement of tile text: top (default, left aligned), center (also horizontally centred), or bottom.

layout.description: How to read each row: auto (default) picks grouped for 3+ columns, path when the first column contains the path separator, else flat; flat forces one level of `label,value`; path splits the first column on path_separator; grouped treats every column except the last as a nesting level.

legend.description: Draw a legend strip under the chart naming each top-level branch with its share. Default false.

max_depth.description: Maximum hierarchy levels to keep, 0-12. Deeper paths are aggregated into their ancestor at this depth. Default 0 keeps every level (hard cap 12).

output.description: Output format: svg (default, self-contained markup), summary (aligned text table of every tile with value, share, and depth), or json (machine-readable nodes with values, shares, and tile rectangles).

palette.description: Tile colour scheme: default (bright), pastel, dusk (deep), earth, ocean, or mono (single-hue ramp built from the color parameter, darkest tile = largest value). Non-mono palettes give each top-level branch its own hue and lighten nested children.

path_separator.description: Separator that splits hierarchy levels when layout is path or auto, for example `/` (default), `>`, or `::`. Ignored for flat and grouped layouts.

show_labels.description: Draw the name of each tile and group when it fits. Default true.

show_percent.description: Draw each tile's share of the grand total as a percentage. Default false; combines with show_values as `1,250 (23.4%)`.

show_values.description: Draw each tile's numeric value under its name when it fits. Default true.

sort.description: Order tiles within each parent: value_desc (default, largest first, best for squarified layout), value_asc, input (order first seen in the data), or label (alphabetical).

theme.description: Chart theme: light (default) or dark. Sets the background and text colours; override the background alone with the background parameter.

tiling.description: Tiling algorithm: squarified (default, near-square tiles that are easiest to compare), slice_dice (strict stripes that alternate direction per level and preserve order), or binary (recursive halving, a middle ground).

title.description: Optional chart title drawn above the tiles, for example `Storage by folder`.

top_n.description: Keep only the largest N children at each level and fold the remainder into a single `Other` tile, 0-500. Default 0 keeps everything; 10-15 is a readable tile count.
